newsitem.title: CANADA: Imasco repeats Canada Trust not for sale.
newsitem.headline: Imasco repeats Canada Trust not for sale.

text.p: Imasco Ltd on Monday emphatically repeated that it had no plans to sell its 98 percent-owned CT Financial Services Inc or merge CT's wholly owned Canada Trust into a bank.
Imasco said that it had no intention of selling CT Financial and despite rumors to the contrary had not been in talks with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.

"Imasco's plans and intentions with respect to its investment in CT Financial Services are very clear," said Imasco Chief Executive Brian Levitt. "Consequently, we have no plans to sell the company or merge it into a bank."
Levitt added that there had been approaches about Canada Trust by potential suitors in the past.

"It must also be acknowledged that at various times since Imasco acquired Canada Trust in 1986, there have been approaches by banking competitors interested in buying the company," Levitt said. "Given the very high quality of Canada Trust's business, this should surprise no one."
Imasco closed unchanged at 42.75 in Toronto today, while CT fell 0.25 to 42.75.
